text:
noah: Postmortem follow-up: we identified three correlated failure vectors during last week's outage: cloud auth token throttling, model-registry fetch errors, and a storage retry amplification. Need owners, concrete timelines, and detection rules.

sylvie: I'll take ownership of the vendor engagement + SLA review (INF-4501). Will pull escalation contacts and ask for a written remediation plan with milestones. ETA 48h.

raj: I'll own the registry-side mitigations (INF-4502). Plan: implement a read-only degraded mode, add a warm local cache for most-requested models, and create a quick rollback procedure. Draft runbook + staging test by next Tuesday.

tess: I'll lead auth hardening (INF-4503): add token issuance rate limits on our clients, short-lived tokens with refresh jitter, and a token-caching layer to reduce issuer QPS. Need Security input on rotation cadence. Target 10 business days for staged rollout.

ops-bot: Epic created: https://tracker.internal/INF-4500 "Dependency outage mitigations: auth + registry + storage". Tasks INF-4501..INF-4507.

noah: Thanks. Two operational asks: (1) add a composite alert that correlates auth latency with registry fetch errors, (2) schedule a monthly recurrence review so we can spot patterns early.

sylvie: Will request vendor remediation SLA and also propose a contractual uptime clause for token endpoints. Looping in Legal once vendor provides timeline.

raj: For the degraded mode, note that aggressive cache TTLs increase stale-result risk. I'll add a staging replay harness to quantify model-quality drift vs TTL and include knobs for TTL and sampling rate.

tess: I'll work with Product on acceptable staleness thresholds and create a degradation matrix (allowable behavior: cache-first, read-only, fail-open). @noah can you assign Product reviewer?

noah: @legal please be ready to review vendor plan focusing on RTO/RPO commitments for token endpoints and support response times.

legal: Will review when vendor remediation plan arrives. Request that the plan includes rollback and verification steps.

raj: Also adding an automated rollback script (feature-flag off + cache purge + traffic reroute) into the runbook. INF-4504.

sylvie: I'll add vendor contact cards to the epic and request a post-incident remediation timeline. If vendor timeline is unclear after 72h, I'll escalate to account execs.

ops-bot: Created alert rule: (auth_p95 > 200ms && registry_fetch_error_rate > 1%) sustained 5m -> page on-call. Added 90-day rolling dashboard to epic. INF-4505.

tess: For token caching TTL safety, I'll coordinate with Raj to run the replay tests and produce a small eval that checks model output divergence under TTL variants. INF-4506.

noah: Owner & ETA summary for epic INF-4500:
- sylvie: vendor SLA & remediation ask (INF-4501)  48h
- raj: registry degraded-mode + staging replay + rollback (INF-4502, INF-4504)  next Tue
- tess: auth hardening + token caching + eval (INF-4503, INF-4506)  10 business days
- ops-bot: composite alert + dashboard (INF-4505)  3 days

noah: I'll set a weekly check-in on the epic and a monthly recurrence review cadence. Please add blockers to the epic and update status as work progresses. If vendor commitment is weak, we'll prepare a procurement/legal escalation.

sylvie: One more note: recommend we ask vendor for a runbook snippet describing their mitigation steps for throttles so we can sync failover behaviors. I'll request that in INF-4501.

raj: Agreed. Also will add a canary traffic test for degraded mode to validate quality impact before enabling in prod.

noah: Great. If no objections I'll move tracking fully into INF-4500 and close this thread. Keep the epic updated. :white_check_mark:
